TextLanguage.description: Select the language of the fix settings; Automatic follows the game.
plugin.name: The Suffering Fusion Fix
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the original bars above and below cutscenes; Pillarbox keeps the cutscene picture at the original 4:3 between side bars; Both does both; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies as the game updates its view.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.CutsceneBorders.help: Off removes cutscene bars. Letterbox: bars above and below. Pillarbox: bars at the sides. Both: the original look.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. The game is made for 60; higher frame rates can upset its physics and timing. Applies immediately.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the chosen resolution, or borderless: a window covering the whole monitor at its resolution. Restart required.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't slip onto another monitor. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the logo movie at startup. Story movies still play. Restart required.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
startup.unsupported: This executable is not supported by the Fusion Fix. Use the original The Suffering or Ties That Bind executable and the latest ASI loader from the fix package. The game starts without the fix.
menu.WindowMode.help: Fullscreen, a window, or borderless. Restart required.
menu.PauseOnFocusLoss.help: Pauses the game while another window is active.
menu.ConfineCursor.help: Keeps the cursor inside the game window.
menu.SkipIntro.help: Skips the startup logo movie. Restart required.
menu.CheckForUpdates.help: Asks fusionfix.io once per start for a newer version.
menu.HudAspectRatioConstraint.help: Auto: HUD at the screen edges. A ratio: a centred box.
menu.FPSLimit.help: Frame rate limit. The game is made for 60.
